title: Baier: Mr. Secretary, you can concede, can't you, that the U.S. doesn't have total control over the Strait of Hormuz?
text:
Baier: Mr. Secretary, you can concede, can't you, that the U.S. doesn't have total control over the Strait of Hormuz?"

"Wright: Are they causing some difficulties for their neighbors and the world economy? Absolutely. But their ability to cause difficulties are declining."

"Baier: That does not sound like total control."

"Finally piece of truth 👆
